project_info.theme: Vintage direct-flash portrait against an aged brick wall
project_info.color_palette: white cotton, leopard print, red-brown brick, silver jewelry and warm amber

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with long auburn hair and bangs, fair freckled skin, dark eyeliner, defined eyebrows and reddish lip color. She smiles broadly while looking slightly off-camera, standing and leaning against a textured brick wall with both hands touching the back of her hair. She wears a white short-sleeved T-shirt knotted at the front waist, leopard-print textured mini shorts, a thick black studded belt, silver chain bracelets, a star pendant necklace and a red thigh-high leg warmer.
main_subject.style: photorealistic candid direct-flash portrait with vintage color and sharp textile detail

composition_elements.layout: vertical portrait with subject leaning back against the brick wall and arms raised
composition_elements.background: rustic indoor bar or hallway with aged reddish-brown exposed brick and a framed gold-patterned artwork
composition_elements.text: No typography required; artwork is a generic gold-patterned framed painting, not a reproduced copyrighted artwork.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: warm ambient interior light mixed with direct on-camera flash
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: high-contrast wall shadow, visible brick texture, vibrant retro colors and slight vignette

technical_specs.render_style: 4K Ultra HD vintage candid flash photography
technical_specs.optics: documentary portrait lens, sharp subject, slight vignette and realistic textile texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4K vintage direct-flash portrait of a clearly adult woman standing and leaning back against a textured aged brick wall. She has long auburn hair with bangs falling past her shoulders, fair skin with visible freckles, dark eyeliner, defined eyebrows and reddish lip color. She smiles broadly with teeth visible while looking slightly off-camera, with both arms raised and hands touching the back of her hair. She wears a white short-sleeved T-shirt tied in a knot at the front waist, leopard-print textured mini shorts, a thick black belt with silver studs, silver chain bracelets on both wrists, a thin necklace with a star pendant and a red thigh-high leg warmer or sock visible on the left leg. Set the scene in a rustic indoor bar, hallway or restaurant with an aged reddish-brown exposed brick wall and a framed generic gold-patterned painting. Mix warm ambient lighting with direct flash to create a high-contrast shadow behind the subject. Use sharp focus, vibrant colors, slight vignette and realistic cotton, sequined-texture and brick detail. Preserve the playful retro outfit, pose, accessories and candid flash concept while keeping the clearly adult fashion framing non-explicit.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, minor, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, copyrighted artwork reproduction, distorted brick
